verdict.rationale: Extend's docs explicitly document SOC 2 Type II alignment, HIPAA (with BAA add-on) and GDPR compliance, plus configurable zero data retention (including for AI subprocessors) at the workspace level, directly matching the data-engineer's need to process contracts and medical records securely. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit confirmation or hands-on customer verification of ZDR/HIPAA in production use beyond vendor docs.
